title: Pseudo-Formalization for Automatic Proof Verification
abstract: arXiv:2605.20531v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reliable verification of proofs remains a bottleneck for training and evaluating AI systems on hard mathematical reasoning. Fully formal proofs, in languages like Lean, are easy to verify because they are unambiguous and modular. Most proofs, particularly those written by AI systems, have neither property, and translating them into formal languages remains challenging in many frontier math settings. We propose Pseudo-Formalization (PF), a proof format that captures the modularity and precision of formal proofs while retaining the flexibility of natural language. A Pseudo-Formal proof is decomposed into self-contained modules, each stating its premises, conclusion, and proof in natural language. To verify the correctness of a regular natural language proof, an LLM translates it to Pseudo-Formal and then verifies each module independently, an algorithm we call Block Verification (BV). translated_title: 用于自动证明验证的伪形式化方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.20531v3 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要：可靠的证明验证仍然是训练和评估AI系统在困难数学推理任务上的瓶颈。完全形式化的证明（例如用Lean等语言编写的证明）由于其无歧义性和模块化而易于验证。然而，大多数证明——尤其是AI系统生成的证明——并不具备这两个特性，而且在许多前沿数学场景中，将它们翻译成形式化语言仍然充满挑战。我们提出了伪形式化（Pseudo-Formalization, PF），这是一种证明格式，它既保留了形式化证明的模块化和精确性，又兼具自然语言的灵活性。一个伪形式化证明被分解为多个自包含的模块，每个模块用自然语言陈述其前提、结论和证明过程。为了验证一个常规自然语言证明的正确性，由大语言模型（LLM）将其翻译为伪形式化格式，然后独立验证每个模块，我们将这一算法称为块验证。我们在两个覆盖不同领域的基准上评估了PF+BV方法……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出伪形式化（PF）证明格式，通过将自然语言证明分解为自包含模块并让大语言模型逐块独立验证（块验证算法BV），在保留自然语言灵活性的同时获得形式化证明的可验证性，从而解决AI数学推理中证明验证的瓶颈问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Pseudo-Formalization (PF), a proof format that decomposes natural language proofs into self-contained modules, which LLMs then verify independently via Block Verification (BV), combining the verifiability of formal proofs with the flexibility of natural language.
